title: The Enemy Lucian Needs
logline: When an ancient threat traps a human hunter with her vampire enemy, she must choose between killing Lucian and joining hands with the monster she hates.
target_audience: Fantasy romance viewers who enjoy dangerous supernatural relationships, forbidden attraction, mystery, and survival-driven enemies-to-allies stories.
hook: The Hunter raises her stake over Lucian—then he warns, "Kill me, and the thing hunting us kills you next."
synopsis: A human Hunter corners the vampire Lucian, but their confrontation awakens an ancient lethal shadow that marks them both. When separation strengthens it, the Hunter chooses to discard her stake and join hands with her enemy. Their combined power opens an escape, while her heartbeat helps Lucian retain control. They cross the threshold together, only to learn the threat now lives inside their fused bond.
episode_goal: Force Lucian and the Hunter to prove that cooperation is their only means of survival, then trap them in a dangerous supernatural bond.

characters.name: Lucian

characters.motivation: Protect his world, contain the awakened threat, and retain control without admitting he needs a human.

characters.name: The Hunter
characters.description: A determined human hunter who distrusts monsters but values survival and truth more than inherited hatred.
characters.motivation: Survive the supernatural threat, expose Lucian's secret, and remain free of his control.
